Description.ShowAttackRange: Draw the local hero's basic attack range.
Description.ShowMonsterThreatRanges: Draw enemy casts, active damage and control zones, and environmental hazards.
Description.ShowProjectileThreatRanges: Draw active enemy projectile paths as rectangular threat zones whose color updates by distance from the hero or time to impact.
Description.EnableAutoDodge: Automatically avoid enemy attacks, damage and control zones, projectiles, and environmental hazards. Choose a point beyond the threat boundary by the character's collision radius plus a small margin, and check both the destination and movement path for safety.
Description.AutoDodgeUseMovementSkill: When normal movement cannot avoid an imminent hit, dodge toward a safe point or parry if Parry Master replaced dodge.
Description.AutoDodgeReserveOneCharge: Prevent auto dodge from consuming the final movement-skill charge.
Description.AutoDodgeLevel: Distance thresholds: Green 1.5, Yellow 1.0, Red 0.5 units. Time-to-impact thresholds: Green 1, Yellow 0.5, Red 0.2 seconds.
Description.AutoDodgeCommandInterval: Minimum interval in seconds for commands to a new destination after replanning. Movement commands are not repeated while the current position is safe or the same destination remains valid.
Description.AutoDodgeKey: None keeps auto dodge always active; otherwise hold this key to activate it.
